name: orb-duel-replay
description: Run the local duel verification (Node suites, build, Chrome replay of seed 0), then the four-step seed-60 showdown on the same standalone build, and report the observed results.

steps.prompt: Run exactly `node scripts/verify-duel.mjs --browser` as one shell call from the project root. Use its standard output and exit status for the test totals, Chrome step count, console errors, revision, build hash and receipt path. The command emits these directly. Signal success only if the check exits zero. On failure give the first failing test or browser step. This step owns verification only.
